The upbeat BGM continues at a consistent volume as the male voice transitions into listing Japanese phrases with exaggerated tonal emphasis. (3) The primary male speaker engages in a conversational dialogue with another male voice; the new voice sounds slightly more relaxed but friendly. The BGM remains as a background bed. Occasional high-pitched 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are used to punctuate specific words in the speech. (4) A short cartoonish laughter track or comedy sting sound effect plays, coinciding with a shift in the speaker's tone toward a teasing or humorous delivery. The background music maintains its tempo, while the male voices exhibit high arousal and playful energy during the interaction. (5) Higher-pitched female voices enter the mix, sounding pleasantly surprised and laughing. The male speakers respond with increased volume and a humorous, slightly strained vocal quality. Multiple quick-succession cartoon sound effects, such as sparkles and pops, are layered over the continuous upbeat music.

It relies on humorous street interactions and high-energy editing to maintain viewer interest.
